introduction: MO HealthNet is Missouri’s Medicaid program. Eligibility varies by income, age, health and care needs.
description: MO HealthNet is Missouri’s Medicaid program. Eligibility varies by income, age, health and care needs.

sections.who: Children, pregnant applicants, parents, adults aged 19–64, older people and disabled applicants have different coverage pathways.
sections.get: Approved applicants receive coverage information and a MO HealthNet identification card. Follow the decision’s start instructions.
sections.docs:

sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use DSS’s health application page, the online portal or 855-373-9994.

  2. Complete any supplemental form

    It is required for listed circumstances including age 65+, disability, Medicare or facility care.

  3. Submit proof

    Use the state’s upload, mail, fax or Resource Center route.
sections.after: Respond to requests and keep contact details current.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using MO HealthNet application. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: An adult coverage category exists; income and other rules apply.
Is an extra form always needed?
Only for the circumstances DSS lists.
